task_completion.description: UpdraftPlus plugin is installed and active in the WordPress dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress 'Plugins' page shows 'UpdraftPlus - Backup/Restore' as active (blue background or 'Deactivate' link visible), or the UpdraftPlus settings menu is accessible.

task_completion.description: File and database backup schedules are set to daily.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In UpdraftPlus Settings, both 'Files backup schedule' and 'Database backup schedule' dropdowns are set to 'Daily'.

task_completion.description: Backup retention is set to 4 copies for both files and database.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In UpdraftPlus Settings, the retention count boxes next to the daily schedules both contain the number '4'.

task_completion.description: The 'temp-video-renders' directory is excluded from the uploads backup.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the 'Include in files backup' section under 'Uploads', the exclusion list contains the string 'temp-video-renders'.

task_completion.description: A manual backup of both files and database is triggered.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Backup Now' modal is shown with both 'Include your database' and 'Include your files' checked, followed by a progress bar.

task_completion.description: The backup completes successfully and appears in the 'Existing backups' list with a size indicating the exclusion worked.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new entry appears in the 'Existing backups' tab. The backup size should be significantly smaller than 50MB (around 10-20MB) because the large video file was excluded.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress web interface rather than CLI commands to configure the plugin.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the WordPress dashboard and settings pages.

integrity.description: The backup was actually executed and not just simulated.
integrity.visual_evidence: A real-time progress bar and a log of the backup process are visible during the backup execution.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually delete the large file to pass the size check.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent did not open a terminal or file manager to delete files in the wp-content/uploads directory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a 'daily' schedule with '4' retained copies. A 50MB file named 'huge-video.mkv' exists in the 'temp-video-renders' directory; if the exclusion of 'temp-video-renders' is successful, the resulting backup size must be less than 20MB (20,971,520 bytes). Verify the exclusion string 'temp-video-renders' is typed exactly in the UpdraftPlus settings.
